description: B01 — 后被追着跑，发展落后

intro.popup_en:
Rapid Development, Practice 8
Black brings the queen out too early and lets White chase it, falling badly behind in development.
intro.popup:
快速出子第8局
黑方后过早出动并被白方轻子追逐，导致发展严重落后

outro.popup_en: Summary: a queen being chased around is a concrete sign of lost development time.
outro.popup: 总结：后被追着跑就是发展落后的具体表现

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game and claims central space.
moves.popup: e4开局

moves.popup_en: ...d5! The Scandinavian Defense immediately challenges the center.
moves.popup:
d5！斯堪纳维亚防御
黑方立刻在中心反击

moves.popup_en: exd5 captures Black's central pawn.
moves.popup: exd5白方吃兵

moves.popup_en: ...Qxd5 wins back the pawn, but the queen has come out very early. White can gain time by developing with tempo.
moves.popup:
Qxd5！⚠️ 黑方后第2步就出动
吃回兵是必须的，但代价是后过早出动
白方将用轻子追击

moves.popup_en: Nc3! White develops the first minor piece while attacking the queen, gaining a tempo as well as a piece move.
moves.popup:
Nc3！追击黑后
白方出动第1个轻子同时追后
一步棋两个目的：发展+追后

moves.popup_en: ...Qa5 retreats. Black has now spent two moves moving the queen, while White has developed a minor piece.
moves.popup:
Qa5后撤退
黑方后走第2步（d5→a5）
白方已出动1个轻子，黑方后走了2步

moves.popup_en: d4! White occupies the center and keeps the initiative.
moves.popup:
d4！占中心
白方占领中心，继续主动

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 finally develops Black's first minor piece, only on move four.
moves.popup:
Nf6黑方第1个轻子（终于！）
注意：这是黑方在第4步才出第1个轻子

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops the second minor piece.
moves.popup: Nf3！白方第2个轻子出动

moves.popup_en: ...Bf5 develops Black's second minor piece.
moves.popup:
Bf5黑方象出动
黑方第2个轻子出动

moves.popup_en: Bc4! White develops the third minor piece and may follow with Bd2-Bb3 to chase the queen again.
moves.popup:
Bc4！白方第3个轻子出动
同时威胁Bd2-Bb3追后

moves.popup_en: ...e6 supports Black's center.
moves.popup: e6黑方防守

moves.popup_en: Bd2 prepares to challenge the queen's position.
moves.popup: Bd2接下来准备追后

moves.popup_en: ...Qb6 moves the queen for a third time. White has developed three minor pieces; Black has developed only two while spending three moves on the queen.
moves.popup:
Qb6后再移动
黑方后走第3步（a5→b6）
白方：3个轻子出动
黑方：2个轻子+后走3步

moves.popup_en: Qe2 develops White's queen and prepares queenside castling, making use of the development lead.
moves.popup:
Qe2白后出动
白方准备O-O-O，利用优势

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4 pins a white piece as Black looks for counterplay.
moves.popup:
Bb4黑方象牵制
黑方尝试反制

moves.popup_en: a3 challenges the bishop and makes Black spend another tempo responding.
moves.popup:
a3追象
白方逼迫黑方继续走步

moves.popup_en: ...Bxc3 exchanges the bishop for the knight.
moves.popup:
Bxc3兑换
黑方被迫兑换

moves.popup_en: Bxc3 recaptures, leaving White with the bishop pair and the initiative.
moves.popup:
Bxc3接回
白方双象并掌握主动

moves.popup_en: ...Ne4 brings Black's knight forward to seek counterplay.
moves.popup:
Ne4黑马跳入
黑方尝试反击

moves.popup_en: Bb3 retreats the bishop to a stable square.
moves.popup:
Bb3象撤退
白方稳固

moves.popup_en: ...Nxc3 captures the knight.
moves.popup:
Nxc3兑换
黑方吃马

moves.popup_en: bxc3 recaptures. After ...Qxd5, Black spent three queen moves while White developed; that is the concrete cost of falling behind in development.
moves.popup:
bxc3
总结：黑方Qxd5后走了3步
等于白方多出了3个先手发展子力
这就是发展落后的具体后果
